quest.title: Chasmic Maze
quest.description: The ground at the bottom of The Chasm suddenly collapsed, causing everyone to fall in. As it turns out, there is an unknown space further below, and everyone works together to investigate...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Ascertain if the Domain leads outside

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That's it, I wanna take another look. And this time, I, Arataki "The One and Oni," will...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Whoa! What's up, sourpuss?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Time for some Roasted Lavender Melon.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? We're trapped in a life and death situation underground, and you're telling me it's time for Roasted Lavender Melon?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Interesting, you hear that? Ushi says you're completely right... Wait, hold on, whose side are you on, Beefcake?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's important to stay replenished. We must keep our energy and morale up in preparation for facing the unknown.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Even Ushi knows that.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Fine, you two... Hey are you already eating?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hold on, is it still warm? Oh, that does smell good... Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Fine, yeah, we'll have a quick snack and then we'll keep looking for a way out. Hey, don't eat them all, leave a couple for me!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wh— Huh? Wait, this ain't right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, how did we end up back here!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So we've been here already?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yes, this is exactly where we started.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But we couldn't have taken a wrong turn, we were headed in the same direction the entire time. We never turned around...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yes, that's what I thought, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Traveler, we were going the right way, weren't we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I thought we were headed in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: There's a legend in Inazuma about a merchant who was tricked by a bake-danuki one evening and kept circling around the same place the whole night. Even by dawn, they still hadn't found a way out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, Paimon's heard that one before too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So we're all familiar with the story then? Good, because I'm pretty sure that's what's happening to us right now.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But fear not, I happen to have a certain sidekick who can exorcise youkai and spirits and whatnot. Let me summon him real quick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unbelievable. An oni who's friends with an exorcist... What an open-minded guy.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: For the boss, ignorance is a virtue.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You're up, Ushi, go get that spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: This is Ushi, an auxiliary member of the Arataki Gang.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Haha, oh, Ushi says hello everyone. You can just call him "Ushi" or "Beefcake." Yeah, he's got a keen sense of direction, so I'll let him lead the way.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I didn't know gangs could have auxiliary members...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This does not have the trappings of something that's gonna work.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You're telling me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Alright, go Ushi! Go find us a way outta here!

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ushi begins looking around for a hidden exit...

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo... Moo, moo... Moo!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that... Really!? Aw, no way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ushi says he's searched everywhere but there's no exit.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That doesn't add up, if we were able to come in, then there must be a way to get out. Here, lemme take another look.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Has anyone else noticed this? We initially thought we fell here from above. At that time, there was a way out high overhead... But now, it seems even that exit has disappeared.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Inexplicable, if you ask me...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It seems there's more than meets the eye with these underground structures.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...I'm gonna take another look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everywhere we look there are just more and more rocks. Uh, maybe we've just misremembered, maybe this isn't the place we started from!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What, you scared now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—No, Paimon's super brave...!

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? Well Ushi also thinks you're scared. It's okay, don't be scared to admit you're uh... scared. You've got us here to protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for you too, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #We can't just sit here twiddling our thumbs, let's keep looking for a way out. Shinobu, you stay here with my precious savior, I'll take {NICKNAME} and Paimon with me.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Got it. Be careful, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Please, there's no need to keep calling me "savior," just Yanfei is fine. Mr. Arataki, it seems that as the head of the Arataki Gang, you possess a strong sense of leadership.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Too kind, too kind. And just call me Itto. Since we're a team now, we should have each other's backs. Paimon, if you feel scared again, I can cover your eyes for you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You split into teams to investigate the surroundings, but fail to find anything...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...*sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems there's really no way out...

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I can't shake the feeling that there's something off about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss, did you guys find anything over there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Not only that, I coulda sworn I saw some shadows moving a second ago... This place better not be haunted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Probably not the right time to ask this, but Paimon just can't help it. Itto, you're an oni... Doesn't that kinda mean everywhere you go is haunted?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No! ...Ignore the red horns, okay? I'm talking about spooky, floaty ghosts, now-you-see-'em, now-you-don't kinda haunted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Itto? Are you... afraid of ghosts?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Oh no, Boss. You've been found out.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What, me? Hah, no way! You kidding? Stop joking around... seriously though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looking at you, Paimon suddenly doesn't feel scared anymore... Hey, Bull-Chucker, if you're scared, Paimon can cover your eyes for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Maybe I should make better use of my time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm? Shinobu walked off to grab a few stones, then she took out some twigs and Lavender Melons from her pocket... What?)

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Add a little salt... and some pepper.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you roasting Lavender Melons?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yeah. Roasted Lavender Melon is delicious. You can try some when it's done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Oh right, there are two types: sweet and savory. Which would you prefer?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm happy with either.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright, you can try them both then. It's important that we remain calm, especially when we are in the throes of a tough situation like this.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: If I'm reading the situation correctly, there seems to be some secret here that the boss and I are not supposed to know about. But don't worry, I'll distract the boss while you discuss things with the others.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ooh, I thought I smelled something cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Would you like some, Yanfei?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thank you, but I'm not hungry. You guys go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, and by the way, I haven't seen you in a while, Shinobu.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yeah, it has been a while, hasn't it? The last time I saw you was when you taught one of my classes as a substitute while I was studying in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Substitute teacher... Ah yes, now I remember. It was during winter, wasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yes, I remember everyone said your lecture was very interesting. Now that I think about it, I should call you "Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ooh, I like the sound of that! Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Who would've ever guessed that we'd get caught up in such a dilemma together. It must be fate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So Yanfei gives lectures too? That's incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Not only that, she's funny and engaging while she speaks. Needless to say, she is very popular among the students.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Haha! Aww, I'm flattered.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I see everyone is still here.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yelan, we split into groups and searched the area, but there are no signs of any way out. How about you? Did you manage to find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: And... though I'd prefer not to say it, we'd better mentally prepare ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If we can't find a way out, we may be stuck underground for some time.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...I think you might be right.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm, an underground space with an entrance but no exit... it just doesn't make any sense. I'll figure something out, just give me some time.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If anyone happens to find a potential exit, please be sure to take every precaution before exploring further.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Come to think of it, Xiao is here, too. He said we can always call his name if we get into trouble.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Maybe it's worth a try...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler? What's with the serious face? Do you have a plan?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I was just thinking that Xiao is also here, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao... oh, right! Do you want to get him to help us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think it's worth a try.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, let's give it a shot!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao, can you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, Xiao?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, no response... Paimon thought Xiao would come no matter where we are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, does that mean even Xiao can't sense our presence here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wonder what that could mean... What's the deal with this place?)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Who could've ever guessed we'd get trapped in a place like this. It's quite the predicament...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: For all the studying I've done in my life, all I know is how to land people in prison... I don't know the first thing about breaking out of one...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I've even made a contract with my father to "live a happy life"... I can't give up hope now.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Try and stay positive... At least I've explored a new place and seen more of the world while reuniting with some old friends.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Uh-huh... Yeah, there's still a silver lining. I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Our situation is grim. There doesn't appear to be a way out for now. We should be prepared to stay for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Fortunately, we don't seem to lack supplies, and even our motley crew has people who can keep their cool when the stakes are high.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Just focus on taking care of yourselves, I'll figure out the rest.
